label: IL0373 status card
info: Every 10 minutes: wake the panel, draw a status card (black header bar, black border, bar chart) and refresh it, then put the controller into deep sleep once the node reports { updated: true }. The refresh blocks the node for about 17 s. Needs a Waveshare 2.13inch e-Paper (D) on SPI0 with DC = GPIO25, RST = GPIO17, BUSY = GPIO24.

name: wake and build status card
